title: Sagalee Obomboleettii Dura
intro: Namni gammoojjii keessa jiru tokko saba humna guddaa qabu tokko gara dhugaatti deebisee waamuuf ka’e. Ummanni kun gamoo dinqisiisaa fi humna gita hin qabneen beekama ture. Taʼus of tuuluun isaanii isaan jaamsee, isaanis dhaggeeffachuu didan. Dhuma irratti adabbiin hamaan isaan mudatee, garee amantoota muraasa qofa qusate.
clues: Ummata humna guddaa qabuu fi lafa banaa keessa jiraatuu fi humna isaaniitiin beekamutti nan ergame.
Sabni koo saba guddaa biraa kan diigame duukaa dhufe.
Caasaa dinqisiisaa kan qaban siʼa taʼu, masaraawwan olkaʼoo ijaaraniiru.
Waaqa Tokkicha akka waaqeffatan isaan waame, isaan garuu waaqa tolfamaa isaanii dhiisuu didan.
Adabbiin cimaan isaan mudate, warra na waliin amanan qofa dhiise.
Ummata jabaa Aad jedhamuun beekamutti kan ergame ana.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Sabni koo bubbee hamaadhaan barbadaa'e, osoon fayye
Sabni koo kirkira lafaa rukutee boo'e
Sabni koo dhagaa samii irraa darbate
Sabni koo ibidda boba'aa keessa darbatame
outcome.answer: Sabni koo bubbee hamaadhaan barbadaa'e, osoon fayye

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
